title: Genistein Ameliorated Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor-A (VEGF-A) and Estrogen Receptor-Alpha (ER-alpha) in Endometriosis Mice Model, In Vivo and In Silico.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体内实验和分子对接考察染料木素对VEGF-A和ER-alpha的抑制作用，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Endometriosis (EM) is a gynecological disorder that causes morbidity in women and is characterized by endometrial tissue in the uterus cavity. This study investigated the mechanism of genistein in the VEGF-A and ER-alpha expression through in vivo and in silico approaches. An in vivo study was conducted by thirty-six mice that were divided into six groups including control, EM, and EM treatment with genistein with the doses of 1.3, 1.95, 2.6, and 3.25 mg/day for 14 days. Peritoneal tissues with lesions were collected and analyzed by immunohistochemistry to measure the VEGF-A and ER-alpha expression. The data were analyzed using a statistical approach using one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey HSD test with a significant value p < 0.05. In silico study was conducted for investigating the inhibition mechanism of genistein in VEGF-A and ER-alpha protein. Genistein significantly reduced the VEGF-A and ER-alpha expression with the optimum dose of 3.25 mg/day. Molecular docking showed that genistein inhibited VEGF-A in several active site residues of VEGF-A, also blocked the ER-alpha protein in estradiol binding sites. This study concluded that genistein prevented endometriosis by performing the antiangiogenic activity and showed a similar function to estradiol.
abstract_zh: 子宫内膜异位症（EM）是一种妇科疾病，导致女性发病，其特征是子宫内膜组织存在于子宫腔外。本研究通过体内和计算机模拟方法探讨了金雀异黄酮在VEGF-A和ER-α表达中的作用机制。体内研究使用三十六只小鼠，分为六组，包括对照组、EM组以及EM治疗组，分别给予金雀异黄酮剂量为1.3、1.95、2.6和3.25毫克/天，持续14天。收集含有病灶的腹膜组织，并通过免疫组织化学分析测量VEGF-A和ER-α的表达。数据采用统计学方法分析，使用单因素方差分析（one-way ANOVA）后进行Tukey HSD检验，显著性水平为p < 0.05。计算机模拟研究用于探讨金雀异黄酮对VEGF-A和ER-α蛋白的抑制机制。金雀异黄酮显著降低了VEGF-A和ER-α的表达，最佳剂量为3.25毫克/天。分子对接显示，金雀异黄酮在VEGF-A的多个活性位点残基处抑制了VEGF-A，并阻断了ER-α蛋白的雌二醇结合位点。本研究得出结论，金雀异黄酮通过发挥抗血管生成活性预防子宫内膜异位症，并表现出与雌二醇相似的功能。
